product.name: MyNote
product.tagline: Your notes, in your storage, in a theme you chose.

rules: Lead with what it does, not how it feels.
Every claim must be checkable in the shipped app.
Never imply end-to-end encryption, real-time collaboration, or AI features — none exist.
Never imply iCloud Drive syncs to Android. It cannot. Google Drive is the cross-platform option.
Say the price plainly: $14.99 once, no subscription. Never write 'free' without saying what is paid.
